The Moen 62365 is an M-PACT Posi-Temp pressure-balancing rough-in valve for single-handle tub and shower installations. It has 1/2 in. cold expansion PEX inlets and 1/2 in. CC (copper sweat) outlets, a 4-port body and no integral stops. The Moen 1222 Posi-Temp cartridge is installed in the valve. Handle, escutcheon, shower head and tub spout are not part of this item and come with the trim kit you choose.

Key Features

  • Posi-Temp pressure-balancing valve that reacts to hot or cold supply pressure changes
  • M-PACT platform: the valve stays in the wall and the trim can be changed later
  • 1/2 in. cold expansion PEX (ASTM F1960) inlets
  • 1/2 in. CC outlets to the shower riser and tub drop
  • 4-port body for tub and shower or shower-only layouts
  • Adjustable temperature limit stop
  • Moen 1222 Posi-Temp cartridge included

What Is Included

  • Posi-Temp rough-in valve body, 4-port, without stops
  • Moen 1222 Posi-Temp pressure-balancing cartridge
  • Adjustable temperature limit stop
  • Not included: handle, escutcheon, shower head, shower arm and tub spout (part of a Posi-Temp trim kit, sold separately)
  • Not included: PEX expansion rings, expansion tool, shutoff stops and piping

Before You Order

  • Trim: this is the in-wall valve only. Order a Moen Posi-Temp trim kit separately and confirm on the trim's specification sheet that it lists M-PACT Posi-Temp valves.
  • Inlets: 1/2 in. cold expansion PEX (ASTM F1960). They need PEX-a tubing, expansion rings and an expansion tool; crimp rings do not fit this connection.
  • Outlets: 1/2 in. CC, soldered to copper.
  • Stops: this model has no integral stops. Check whether your code or building requires stops at the valve.
  • Wall depth: set the valve to the finished-wall dimension shown on Moen's installation sheet, allowing for tile or surround thickness.

Specifications

  • Brand: Moen
  • Manufacturer Part #: 62365
  • Valve: M-Pact Posi-Temp
  • Connection: 1/2 in. cold expansion PEX inlets, CC outlets
  • Pressure balancing: Yes
  • Packaging: Bulk pack
  • UPC: 026508227251
  • Category: Shower and Tub-Shower Valves

The GROHE 27814001 is the Rainshower Cosmopolitan 210 shower head in StarLight Chrome, a single-spray rain head with an 8 in. face and 120 spray nozzles. GROHE DreamSpray distributes water evenly across the nozzles, and the SpeedClean nozzles can be wiped to remove limescale. The shower arm is sold separately.

  • Rainshower Cosmopolitan 210, GROHE StarLight Chrome finish
  • 8 in. spray face with 120 nozzles
  • One rain spray pattern
  • 1.75 GPM (6.6 L/min) maximum flow, WaterSense labeled
  • 1/2 in. NPT female connection with ball joint
  • GROHE DreamSpray for even water distribution
  • SpeedClean anti-lime nozzles

What Is Included

  • Shower head with ball joint
  • Not included: shower arm. GROHE recommends Rainshower arm 28577, 28492 or 27217
  • Not included: shower valve and trim

Before You Order

  • Connection: 1/2 in. NPT female, which fits a standard US shower arm.
  • Shower arm: order one separately. GROHE recommends its Rainshower arms 28577, 28492 or 27217 for this head.
  • Flow: 1.75 GPM maximum. Check any local limit on shower flow rate.
  • Headroom: an 8 in. rain head sits lower and farther out than a small head. Check the arm height and length.

Specifications

  • Brand: Grohe
  • Manufacturer Part #: 27814001
  • UPC: 4005176487415
  • Category: Single-Function Shower Heads
